newsitem.title: USA: Tandy sees earnings up through fiscal year.
newsitem.headline: Tandy sees earnings up through fiscal year.

text.p: Tandy Brands Accessories Inc on Tuesday said that it sees increased earnings through the remainder of its fiscal year.

"We expect our strategic initiatives to continue to enhance our opportunities to realize increased earnings throughout the balance of our fiscal year ending June 30, 1997," J.S.B. Jenkins, Tandy's president and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
"While sales in certain sectors of the retail market remain soft, the strategic initiatives executed by Tandy Brands in the last 18 months have begun to pay off," he added.
Earlier, Tandy reported first quarter earnings of $0.20 per share versus $0.16 in the year ago period.
